description: Linearized Regional Seismic Loss Estimation with PPCA is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "software", published or maintained by SoungEil Houng, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (lbl.gov). Regional seismic loss modeling using linearization of GM-Fragility coupling and PPCA. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "software" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-9hbb-c610. Keywords: earthquake risk modeling, regional earthquake loss estimation, scenario-based assessment, Probabilistic Principal Component Analysis, ground-motion intensity, fragility curve. Published 2026-03-07. Facility named: UC Berkeley. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 3-Clause BSD License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
